description: Renders a public page in a real headless Chromium with JavaScript executed, then returns the result as clean markdown, plain text or HTML: single-page apps, infinite-scroll feeds, client-side dashboards and anything the cheap fetch-based reader returns empty for. Waits for the network to go quiet, optional extra settle time, navigation, ads and trackers removed. Price: $0.02 USDC per call (x402).

wait_ms.description: Extra milliseconds to wait after the page loads, 0-8000 (default 0)
